title: Rush Word
description:
Rush Word is a fast-paced typing and word challenge game focused on speed, accuracy, vocabulary, and score chasing.

Type words as quickly as possible, complete words letter by letter, translate between multiple languages, build combos, and try to beat your personal best or your opponent. Every round tracks your score, completed words, combo, best combo, accuracy, mistakes, and WPM.

Play solo to improve your typing speed, or invite a friend through Steam and compete in online multiplayer matches. Rush Word supports classic typing gameplay, translation challenges, and extra challenge modes.

New and improved features include:

- Fast typing challenges

- Single-player mode

- Online Steam invite multiplayer

- 1v1 multiplayer

- 1v1v1v1 match option

- Word translation modes

- Selectable translation direction

- Random translation mode

- English, Czech, Slovak, German, and French word support

- Optional diacritics

- Word length settings

- Difficulty settings

- Custom time setting

- Hints with score penalty

- One Life mode

- Practice mode

- Ranked mode

- Word Storm mode

- Operation Shield mode

- Player XP and level progression

- Player titles

- Weekly challenges

- Local top 10 scores

- Steam stats, achievements, and leaderboards

- Steam Cloud save support

- Steam Deck support with touch keyboard input

In Word Storm, correct words add time in single-player, while mistakes remove time and increase the pressure.

In Operation Shield, every mistake damages your shield. Type accurately, repair your shield with correct words, and survive as long as possible.

Rush Word is designed for short, replayable rounds where every word matters. Improve your speed, expand your vocabulary, build better combos, climb the leaderboards, and prove that you can think and type faster than your opponent.
description_short: Rush Word is a fast-paced competitive typing game where players race through word challenges, translations, combos, and new modes like Word Storm and Operation Shield. Play solo, improve your level, or challenge friends in online Steam invite matches.
